Long before the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], a '''rebellion''' carried out by [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] individuals broke out on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]]. However, the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Bestia]] single-handedly crushed the rebellion, defeating the enslaved individuals and restoring Imperial control.
